summary.business_type: Personal portfolio / freelance UX-UI design & development services (bilingual EN / zh-Hant)
top_findings: andrewthyip.com does not rank for Andrew's own name in search (LinkedIn and unrelated namesakes dominate)
/work/yocale/ ships ~82MB of uncompressed GIFs on one page, one with fetchpriority=high
Confirmed-real TBT failure (up to 2200ms) on three /ch/ routes, re-verified with isolated Chrome instances
No coherent Person/ProfessionalService entity graph in structured data (zero @id usage sitewide)
/about/ and /services/about/ (and /contact/ and /services/contact/) serve identical body content at separate sitemapped URLs
quick_wins: Add datePublished/dateModified to case-study CreativeWork schema
Increase mobile nav hamburger hit area to 48x48px
Add one citable sentence around each case-study stat-card metric

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt open and correct, sitemap referenced
Hreflang fully reciprocal across every EN/zh-Hant pair
Fully static/SSR output - zero JS-rendering risk for any crawler

findings.title: Multi-megabyte GIFs served on case-study pages, one with fetchpriority=high
findings.description: /work/yocale/ and its /ch/ twin ship ~82-90MB of GIFs across 5 files (up to 32MB single file); /work/crowd-ease/ carries a further ~11MB; 404.astro preloads a 9.4MB GIF with fetchpriority=high.
findings.recommendation: Convert to compressed video (mp4/webm) or WebP the same way already done for Delta Controls; remove fetchpriority=high unless verified as the actual LCP element.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header missing
findings.description: No CSP anywhere on the site; vercel.json has no headers block at all.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP allow-listing GTM, Ahrefs, GSAP CDN, and Google Fonts; start in Report-Only mode.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
findings.description: Confirmed absent on HTML and static asset responses.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff in vercel.json headers block.

findings.title: X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors missing
findings.description: Site can be embedded in an iframe on any third-party domain - clickjacking exposure on the contact form.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or fold into CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.title: www to apex redirect uses temporary 307 instead of permanent
findings.description: https://www.andrewthyip.com redirects with 307; apex's own HTTP-to-HTTPS upgrade correctly uses 308.
findings.recommendation: Set the www redirect to permanent (308) in Vercel domain settings.

findings.title: IndexNow protocol not implemented
findings.description: No IndexNow key file or ping calls found; Bing/Yandex/Naver rely on normal crawl schedule instead of near-instant re-crawl.
findings.recommendation: Generate an IndexNow key, add the key file, ping on content changes via a simple CI step.

findings.title: HSTS lacks includeSubDomains and preload
findings.description: Strict-Transport-Security present with 2-year max-age but missing both directives needed for HSTS preload list eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add includeSubDomains; preload, then submit to hstspreload.org.

findings.title: 404 page has no meta robots noindex, unnecessary self-canonical
findings.description: 404 status code is normally sufficient, but this is cheap defense-in-depth.
findings.recommendation: Add meta name=robots content=noindex,nofollow; drop the canonical tag on 404.astro.

findings.title: No apple-touch-icon
findings.description: iOS Add to Home Screen falls back to a page screenshot instead of the logo.
findings.recommendation: Add a 180x180 apple-touch-icon.png and matching link tag.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Six real, named testimonials with verifiable employers (Delta Controls Inc., IBM)
Three of four case studies have real depth and specific metrics tied to named clients
Hreflang correct and reciprocal across every page pair

findings.title: Homepage carries almost no indexable/citable content
findings.description: / and /ch/ render ~11 words of visible text (two headlines, two CTAs); entity info exists only in JSON-LD, not visible/crawlable text.
findings.recommendation: Add a short always-visible positioning statement or name/role/location line near the split panels.

findings.title: /about/ and /services/about/ are duplicate content
findings.description: Identical 679-word body text (character-for-character), both self-canonicalized, both in sitemap.xml. Same pattern on the /ch/ pair.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one canonical URL with a 301, or differentiate the copy per audience and cross-canonicalize.

findings.title: /contact/ and /services/contact/ are duplicate content
findings.description: Identical 45-word body text, same duplication pattern as About.
findings.recommendation: Same fix pattern as the About duplication.

findings.title: /portfolio/ and /services/work/ are near-duplicate hub pages
findings.description: Verbatim project-card descriptions, ~85%+ content overlap, differ only in framing sentence.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate project blurbs per page intent, or canonicalize one to the other.

findings.title: Ant Rentals case study is significantly thinner than its siblings
findings.description: 188 words vs. 510-857 words for Delta/Yocale/Crowd Ease; lacks their Problem/Solution structure.
findings.recommendation: Bring up to parity with an explicit Problem/Solution breakdown and named stakeholders.

findings.title: No freshness/date signals on case studies
findings.description: No datePublished/dateModified in any CreativeWork schema; no visible published/updated date.
findings.recommendation: Add datePublished (completion) and dateModified (last edit) to each case study.

findings.title: Trust signal gaps for a freelance services business
findings.description: Personal Gmail contact address instead of branded domain email; no phone/address; no privacy policy despite a data-collecting contact form.
findings.recommendation: Set up a branded email, add a short privacy note, consider stating service area/timezone explicitly.

findings.title: /services/ is below the service-page word-count floor
findings.description: 682 words vs. a ~800-word topical-coverage guidance floor.
findings.recommendation: Add a lightweight FAQ block covering timeline, pricing range, and process.

findings.title: Images with missing or empty alt attributes
findings.description: /work/ant/ has 8 images with no alt attribute at all and 6 with empty alt; /work/crowd-ease/ has 12 with no alt attribute.
findings.recommendation: Audit flagged images, add descriptive alt to any conveying real content, reserve empty alt for genuinely decorative fills.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All 40 JSON-LD blocks across 24 pages are syntactically valid
Zero deprecated schema types found anywhere
All URLs absolute in structured data

findings.title: Testimonial Review/ItemList markup is self-serving and ineligible for rich results
findings.description: Reviews about the site owner's own service, published by the site owner, on 4 canonical URLs (about, services/about, and both /ch/ twins) - against Google's review-snippet eligibility guidelines regardless of content authenticity.
findings.recommendation: Remove Review/ItemList typing and keep testimonials as plain HTML, or retype as a generic CreativeWork/Quotation list which doesn't carry the self-serving restriction.

findings.title: ProfessionalService never defined as a real entity
findings.description: Only appears as a bare 3-property stub, copy-pasted 24 times site-wide; no address, telephone, areaServed, or links back to Person.
findings.recommendation: Define ProfessionalService once in full, link bidirectionally to Person via @id.

findings.title: No @id used anywhere; Person entity duplicated with inconsistent properties
findings.description: Person block varies page to page with no shared identifier across roughly 10 instances.
findings.recommendation: Adopt one canonical Person node with @id, reference via short-form {@id: ...} elsewhere.

findings.title: Identical testimonial payload duplicated across 4 files with no shared source
findings.description: Same 6-review JSON-LD block hand-copied into about.astro, services/about.astro, and both /ch/ twins.
findings.recommendation: Extract into a shared data file imported by all 4 pages.

findings.title: /portfolio has no page-level schema or ItemList of its case studies
findings.description: Ships only the minimal Person object also used on the homepage; no WebPage/CollectionPage identity, no structured enumeration of the 4 case studies it lists.
findings.recommendation: Add a CollectionPage with a mainEntity ItemList referencing each case study.

findings.title: Testimonial content on zh-Hant pages is untranslated English with no inLanguage tag
findings.description: Sibling Person block correctly declares inLanguage zh-Hant but the following Review block has no tag and is entirely English.
findings.recommendation: Translate the content or explicitly mark the block inLanguage en.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList never carries inLanguage on zh-Hant pages
findings.description: Inconsistent with the CreativeWork block on the same page which does declare it.
findings.recommendation: Add inLanguage zh-Hant to BreadcrumbList blocks for consistency.

findings.title: English-locale pages never declare inLanguage at all
findings.description: Asymmetric pattern versus the zh-Hant side, which does declare it.
findings.recommendation: Add inLanguage en to EN-page JSON-LD for parity.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: CLS is a non-issue everywhere (0-0.041, all Good)
font-display-insight shows zero estimated savings - web font loading already ruled out as an LCP cause

findings.title: LCP element is text everywhere; render delay, not network, is the bottleneck
findings.description: The measured LCP element on every tested page is a headline or paragraph, never an image/video; element render delay runs 2.3-3.4 seconds despite trivial TTFB.
findings.recommendation: Do not spend effort re-compressing hero media to fix LCP specifically; focus on removing render-blocking work between HTML parse and first paint.

findings.title: A ~91-94KB same-origin hashed script is the top render-blocking resource on every page
findings.description: Contributes 900-1640ms of render-blocking duration on every route tested; high-confidence identified as Ahrefs Analytics' same-origin proxy fetch.
findings.recommendation: Delay analytics initialization until after window.load or via requestIdleCallback.

findings.title: Critical TBT on three /ch/ routes, confirmed real via isolated re-test
findings.description: /ch/services/, /ch/work/yocale/, /ch/work/delta/ scored 51-64 with TBT 1174-2200ms across two independent test runs including fresh isolated Chrome instances.
findings.recommendation: Fix GSAP/ScrollTrigger interaction with oversized media on /work/yocale/ (2287-2500ms attributed to gsap.min.js there specifically); independently fix the underlying media weight.

findings.title: Case-study and portfolio pages ship 12.6-27MB of largely unoptimized media
findings.description: Multiple routes carry double-digit-MB payloads from unconverted GIFs and suspiciously large SVGs (likely embedded raster data).
findings.recommendation: Convert GIFs to video, investigate embedded raster data in oversized SVGs, dedupe any accidentally-doubled video fetches.

findings.title: Chinese pages carry a consistent 1.8-2.4MB CJK webfont tax and near-double request count
findings.description: Noto Serif/Sans TC pre-sliced into ~28 unicode-range files per page; request counts nearly double versus English equivalents.
findings.recommendation: Consider whether all 3 weights of both font families are needed, or fall back to system CJK fonts for body copy.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: All major AI crawlers confirmed allowed and reachable (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended)
llms.txt present, accurate, and genuinely well-maintained
Strong, descriptive image alt text on sampled pages

findings.title: Key metrics isolated as bare numbers with no citable sentence
findings.description: All 4 case studies present headline stats as two disconnected paragraph tags with no subject, verb, or causal claim connecting them.
findings.recommendation: Add one self-contained sentence per stat connecting the number to the claim and client.

findings.title: Case-study prose fragmented well below optimal citation length
findings.description: Paragraphs run 12-48 words; none reach the 134-167 word range associated with highest AI-citation rates.
findings.recommendation: Add one consolidated ~150-word answer paragraph per major section, prioritizing Yocale and Delta.

findings.title: Section headings are declarative, not question-based
findings.description: No headings phrased as questions across any case study, reducing match rate against natural-language AI search queries.
findings.recommendation: Reframe 2-3 headings per case study as questions where it doesn't fight the existing design voice.

findings.title: No datePublished/dateModified in case-study structured data
findings.description: AI answer engines have no freshness signal to judge whether cited metrics are current.
findings.recommendation: Add both date fields to each case study's CreativeWork schema.

findings.title: Homepage carries almost no extractable text
findings.description: ~79 words total; all entity information lives in JSON-LD rather than visible/citable prose on the URL most likely to be cited first.
findings.recommendation: Add a short visible or sr-only summary paragraph restating the Person entity's key facts.

findings.title: No RSL 1.0 machine-readable licensing alongside the llms.txt content-licensing note
findings.description: llms.txt states an attribution requirement in prose only; no machine-readable backing file.
findings.recommendation: Publish a minimal RSL 1.0 file if maximizing AI-search visibility is a stated goal; low priority given site scale.

findings.title: Missing alt attributes on case-study images
findings.description: /work/ant/ (8 images, no alt) and /work/crowd-ease/ (12 images, no alt) have real content images with no accessibility/SEO alt text.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text; audit which empty-alt images are genuinely decorative versus mislabeled.
